reason: Playwright's selectors.setTestIdAttribute chooses the attribute that getByTestId reads, for the page and for the test's later queries. Strider's getByTestId reads data-testid only, and it has no setting for the attribute, so a page's custom test-id attribute can't be read, nor a list of attributes that matches any of them
Playwright's getByTestId takes a regular expression, which matches the test id's text. Strider's getByTestId takes a string, and matches data-testid exactly

Playwright's getByRole takes a description option, matched against the element's accessible description (aria-describedby, or the title fallback), by substring, exactly, or as a regular expression. Strider's RoleOptions has name and state filters but no description, so these checks have no Strider call to make
